scripts.deploy: pnpm run db:migrations:apply && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run db:migrations:apply --env production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.db:migrations:apply: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Stores accounts, feeds, connections, and post history.

EMAIL.description: Requires a domain onboarded in Cloudflare Email Service for sign-in emails.

NUXT_BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep private and stable across deployments.

NUXT_BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Your instance's HTTPS URL, such as `https://parrot.your-account.workers.dev`. Replace the development default.

NUXT_EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address on your onboarded Cloudflare Email Service domain.

NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Your instance's HTTPS URL. Also set this in the build environment for site metadata.

POSTHOG_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional. Set in the build environment to enable your own PostHog project; leave empty to disable.

POSTHOG_HOST.description: Optional PostHog ingestion host, configured at build time.

POSTHOG_CLI_HOST.description: Optional build-only PostHog API host for source-map uploads.

POSTHOG_CLI_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional build-only project ID for source-map uploads.

POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY.description: Optional build-only personal API key for source-map uploads. Never expose publicly.
